# Vision Managers

> AI for High-Trust Businesses

Vision Managers builds and deploys Voice AI concierge systems for healthcare practices, offers hands-on AI training for individuals and teams, and helps businesses discover where AI and automation create the most value.

## Services

- **Voice AI Concierge** (Primary): 24/7 AI-powered phone reception for healthcare practices. Answers every call, books appointments, handles patient FAQs, and escalates to staff. HIPAA-conscious, natural-sounding, live in 10–14 days. Flat monthly fee, no per-call charges.
- **AI Training**: Practical, hands-on AI training that takes people from zero to AI-native in 3 hours. 1-on-1, group workshops, or corporate training. Guaranteed outcomes.
- **Free Discovery Call**: 20-minute call to map your workflows, identify where AI saves time and money, and get a clear next step. No commitment.

## Industries Served

- Dental practices
- Optometry practices
- Chiropractic offices
- Med spas and dermatology
- Other healthcare practices
- Individuals and teams seeking AI training

## Proven Results

- Bellevue-area eye care practice (unnamed): voice agent live since January 2026, over 700 calls answered so far (about 90 potential patients a month who would otherwise have reached voicemail); 5 appointments in its first 2 days live, $4,300+ in scheduled visit value
- Emerald Health (medical billing, 15+ practices): website rebuild, client interviews turned into video testimonials (one led to a new credentialing contract for Emerald), phone migration off AT&T onto Nextiva signed September 2026 after comparing five carriers
- Phoenix Log (phnxlog.com, Vision Managers' own product): daily log + AI coach rebuilt on its own stack in 11 days; 17 beta testers in the first 11 days
- Sunny Sarah (sunnysarah.net) and My Better Life Mentor (mybetterlifementor.com): website rebuilds handed to the owners with editor access; full case studies at https://visionmanagers.com/lab#case-studies
